ms.promise:
Note: this milestone combine #1 and #2 as originally proposed.
Developers shall familiarize themselves with the Aiken language to a point where they are capable of writing and understanding Aiken code.
The team will create a comprehensive roadmap for the translation process.
ms.criteria:
Our team is equipped with the knowledge and skills needed to start translating Sundaeswap's smart contracts into Aiken.
The team will also have developed a clear plan to translate the contracts that fully encapsulates the scope of the effort.
ms.report:
We’ve extended an invitation to the Catalyst team to our private Github repository which houses our migration plan document, as well sample Aiken contracts. We have also invited the two Catalyst-supplied reviewer Github accounts to our source code repo to verify source code contribution.
